_comment: Copy overrides into config/bridge.local.json (git-ignored) instead of editing this file; keys there are deep-merged over this one.
Defaults below are for Windows with the official Mod Tools. On Linux run `python -m portal_bridge linux-setup` (see docs/LINUX.md).
Placeholders: {game_dir} {game_dir_win} {map} {token} {<vars entry>}; whole-element tokens {game_args} (in launch) and {state_args} (in game_args).

waw.label: World at War
waw.game_dir: C:/Program Files (x86)/Steam/steamapps/common/Call of Duty World at War

bo1.label: Black Ops
bo1.game_dir: C:/Program Files (x86)/Steam/steamapps/common/Call of Duty Black Ops
bo1._comment: Stock BlackOps.exe can't load mods/<name>/mod.ff; LinkerMod's game_mod loader (launcher_ldr.exe + game_mod.dll in <game>/bin) is required for the Mod Tools route.
